title: Enterprise Association Consumer Correction
objective: Make Enterprise dossiers consume the candidate Programme and Opportunity relationships already present and resolved in the imported Twin.
implementation_summary: Reused import-scoped candidate relationship resolution as the sole Enterprise association truth owner.
Corrected the shared Enterprise consumer to apply governed relationship type and direction semantics and deduplicate by business-object identity.
Added exact-ID reconciliation to Enterprise dossiers and Advanced Inspection without changing candidate governance.
expected_visible_outcomes: BT Group: 1 explicitly related Programme and 3 explicitly related Opportunities; PROG-BT-VERIZON-JV remains absent while OPP-BT-VERIZON-JV-INTEGRATION appears.
Virgin Media O2: 2 unique Programmes and 3 Opportunities.
Advanced Inspection visibly reconciles resolved and rendered exact ID sets and reports truthful association anomalies.
Protected populations remain 17 Opportunities and 13 Programmes; factual dimensions remain isolated; no candidate is automatically promoted.
unchanged_areas: Archive and manifest ingestion, validation, candidate creation, relationship resolver, TEL-001 fixture, Canonical Factual Projection, promotion, review, assessment, recommendation, and Observation architecture remain unchanged.
required_test_steps: Open each of the six TEL-001 Enterprise dossiers and reconcile the displayed IDs.
Confirm BT excludes PROG-BT-VERIZON-JV and includes OPP-BT-VERIZON-JV-INTEGRATION.
Open Advanced Inspection and confirm every Enterprise association row is PASS.
Confirm Major Programmes has 13 and Opportunities has 17 distinct rendered business-object containers.
fresh_import_policy: No fresh import is required because this consumer-only correction reads existing resolved candidates in their original import scope.
known_limitations: Deployment metadata may be incomplete; functional acceptance remains testable when all automated functional checks pass.

automated_validation.known_failing_tests: None in focused population/relationship acceptance suite.

operator_validation_status: PASS — exact association sets and rendered routes reconciled
merge_mode: unverified until GitHub merge metadata or deployed change marker is available
fresh_import_required: No — the correction reads already-resolved candidate relationships and does not rebuild persisted candidate state.
